summary: Executed backend contract tests (3D API), browser stall reproduction, deterministic WebGL fixture run, and physics harness checks. Backend APIs passed, but physics behavior regressions found and mirror startup remained flaky under normal synthetic webcam feed.

ui_bugs.issue: Repeated Playwright reads of model-status timed out while UI stayed visible; screenshot often shows FPS 0 + POSE 0/33 + LOADING-SHIRT. Startup is flaky in headless synthetic camera runs.

integration_issues.issue: Console repeatedly records aborted static/model requests during flaky runs (e.g., /api/static/shirt.glb net::ERR_ABORTED).
Stationary input does not settle enough and motion concentrates deformation near upper shoulder zone more than lower cloth region.

action_items: Investigate mirror startup flakiness under synthetic webcam/headless: why model-status polling stalls and /api/static/shirt.glb gets aborted in some runs.
Tune clothSimulation damping/constraint behavior so stationary inputs settle faster and deformation is stronger below shoulder than upper pinned region.
Provide a first-class automated frontend physics test command (Jest currently fails on Three ESM import path) or move harness under a supported runner.
Retest full two-page mirror<->remote sync after startup issue is fixed (phone->mirror observed once; mirror->phone full flow incomplete due repeated runtime timeouts).
critical_code_review_comments: takeSnapshot calls scene.render() before canvas copy; combined with preserveDrawingBuffer=false this pattern correlates with frequent GPU 'ReadPixels' stall warnings in logs.
Frontend currently has no stable built-in automated physics test pipeline for poseFit/clothCage/clothSimulation with real GLB data.
The app code is browser-correct, but extensionless local imports (e.g., ./clothCage) complicate direct Node harness execution without patching.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple temporary sessions via /api/sessions during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deterministic TEST-ONLY pose fixture via bundle route patch successfully produced DRAPE LIVE and visible shirt rendering screenshots. Natural synthetic webcam flow remains flaky with repeated model-status read timeouts and occasional /api/static/shirt.glb abort logs. Physics harness output (frontend/tests/physics_pose_harness.mjs) currently fails on: 1) settleDelta=0.024873100745221293, 2) lowerAvg deformation < upperAvg deformation.
rca of the issue: Repro for physics issue: run `node --experimental-default-type=module ./tests/physics_pose_harness.mjs` in /app/frontend. It decodes real /backend/static_garments/shirt.glb and drives clothSimulation over hundreds of frames. Failures indicate damping/constraint distribution keeps persistent oscillation and upper region moving more than lower region under motion. Repro for startup flake: open /mirror?s={token} with preselected garment in headless synthetic camera; HUD can stay at LOADING-SHIRT + FPS0 while console shows intermittent net::ERR_ABORTED for static/model requests. Mitigation candidates: reduce render/readback pressure around capture, verify async load cancellation/race around scene.loadShirt and polling updates, and retest with deterministic pose fixture + non-headless browser.
